security_spec.violation_condition: The kernel sets sstatus.SDT (or a nested guest's vsstatus.SDT) as part of double-trap handling in S-mode/HS-mode, then executes SRET to return to U/VU-mode on hardware that does NOT implement Ssdbltrp, relying solely on the SRET instruction to clear the SDT bit.
security_spec.summary: SRET/MRET clearing of SDT/MDT is gated on DblTrp extension presence; kernel must not assume hardware clears these bits on xRET unless it first verifies Ssdbltrp/Smdbltrp is implemented, or stale SDT will cause spurious double-trap on next U-mode exception
